## Summary

Implemented `membershipNumber` as a server-derived, read-only field formatted `<customerCode>-M<YY>`, following the exact pattern the codebase already uses for other computed owner fields (`displayName`, `initials`, `householdId`).

Two files changed:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added the `membershipNumber` property to the Owner schema (read-only), so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field.
2. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — added one `@Mapping(expression=...)` line on `toOwnerDto` plus a small null-safe `membershipNumber(Owner)` helper that returns `String.format("%s-M%02d", customerCode, registrationDate.getYear() % 100)`.

**Why this keeps structural impact low:** deriving the value at mapping time meant no changes to the `Owner` entity, no new pipeline function class, and no YAML wiring — the existing `AssignCustomerCode` step and `BuildOwner` (which defaults `registrationDate` to today) already populate both source fields before save. The only edited existing method (`toOwnerDto`) gained a single annotation line, and the new helper is a fresh, cohesive method with `CC=3` and minimal surrounding context. The null guard is required because seed owners have no `customerCode`/`registrationDate`, so their serialization returns `null` rather than throwing.

The membership test and the full suite pass.

Implemented `membershipNumber` as a server-derived, read-only field formatted `<customerCode>-M<YY>`, following the exact pattern the codebase already uses for other computed owner fields (`displayName`, `initials`, `householdId`).

Two files changed:

1. **`openapi.yml`** — added the `membershipNumber` property to the Owner schema (read-only), so the generated `OwnerDto` carries the field.
2. **`OwnerMapper.java`** — added one `@Mapping(expression=...)` line on `toOwnerDto` plus a small null-safe `membershipNumber(Owner)` helper that returns `String.format("%s-M%02d", customerCode, registrationDate.getYear() % 100)`.

**Why this keeps structural impact low:** deriving the value at mapping time meant no changes to the `Owner` entity, no new pipeline function class, and no YAML wiring — the existing `AssignCustomerCode` step and `BuildOwner` (which defaults `registrationDate` to today) already populate both source fields before save. The only edited existing method (`toOwnerDto`) gained a single annotation line, and the new helper is a fresh, cohesive method with `CC=3` and minimal surrounding context. The null guard is required because seed owners have no `customerCode`/`registrationDate`, so their serialization returns `null` rather than throwing.
